ns2:section.sectionText: This course is intended for students who have taken CS 373 and are required to take an algorithms course. Students who have taken CS 374 (currently CS 498 section B) who would like a follow-on algorithms course should register for CS 498 Section D)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Computer Science or Statistics & Computer Science or Math & Computer Science or Computer Sci & Anthropology or Computer Sci & Astronomy or Computer Sci & Chemistry or Computer Sci & Linguistics major(s).
